Description: Replace the single-row Dr/Cr layout with journal_headers + journal_lines so that multi-line entries (1:N, N:1, N:N) become possible without changing any historical figure.
Justification: Required for contractor certification, retention and payroll entries which are inherently multi-line.

Enhancement: Counterparty master separated from cost centres
Description: Create a single counterparties table with sub-types (contractor, supplier, employee, advance holder, shareholder, government entity, other). The 53 distinct funding recipients in the ledger become counterparty records.
Justification: File 2 Policy 13 already forbids treating contractors as cost centres; the ledger currently carries them only as free text.

Description: Rename 211090 to "Other Payables" and carry Hassan Yaqoub as the counterparty on JV-1028.
Justification: A person's name inside an account name prevents reuse and breaks the counterparty subledger.

Enhancement: Funding batch as a first-class object
Description: Introduce funding_batches keyed on the source reference series (AMER-nnn, ABS-nn, ABA-nn, DF-nnn, TAJ-DAR-nn, ACC-JV-…) so that every journal line inherits a traceable funding batch instead of a free-text source reference.
Justification: Every reconciliation in File 1 is performed by source population; the system must be able to reproduce it natively.

Enhancement: Chain-step as an enumerated control field
Description: Persist the 12 funding-chain steps as an enumeration on the journal line and validate the permitted account pairs per step.
Justification: The chain-step is what makes the three-level control computable.

Description: Keep an explicit date_status enumeration (OK / NO DATE IN SOURCE / MISSING / INCONSISTENT) so that the 311 undated historical entries remain visible rather than being given an invented date.
Justification: Assignment §37 forbids fabricating dates; the field is the mechanism that enforces it.

Description: Build a proper indirect-method cash flow statement alongside the management funds-flow summary, and name them differently on screen.
Add a Statement of Changes in Equity covering capital, contributions pending registration, reserves, retained earnings and the current result.
Justification: Required once capital is registered and results are struck.

Description: Build contracts and work_packages as master tables with amendments and change orders, rather than as free-text journal columns.
Justification: Needed before certified-work accounting can be operated.

Description: Attach evidence to the journal header and line with a controlled status (Complete / Partial / Missing) that feeds the exceptions report and can never be silently cleared.
Apply the same Draft → Submitted → Reviewed → Approved workflow to the Chart of Accounts and master data as to journals.
Justification: Assignment §6 requires COA changes to be controlled and logged.

Description: Hold the share percentage, eligibility flags and effective dates in a parameter table with full history.
Justification: Assignment §14 — must be parameter-driven and auditable.

Description: Add issue date, settlement deadline and aging buckets to the advance record and drive an exception when the deadline passes.

Enhancement: Bilingual account and dimension names as separate fields
Description: Store Arabic and English names in separate columns everywhere (already the case in the COA) and render by user language.
Justification: Enables a true RTL Arabic UI without string parsing.

Description: Implement the File 1 duplicate tests as a service: exact amount + counterparty + period, exact source reference, and near-date matching, returning a score and a required disposition.
Justification: The 700,595,000 of potential duplicates must remain visible and dispositionable in the system.

Enhancement: Immutable posted entries with controlled reversal
Description: Once posted, an entry can only be reversed or adjusted by a new entry carrying a reason and a link to the original.
Drive every financial statement line from a report_mappings table rather than from code.
Record the responsible accountant and last physical count date per cash account and require them at period close.
